summary: The Playwright test is syntactically correct and will execute without errors; however, the selector used appears weak and potentially incorrect for the test case intent, and the test lacks assertions strong enough to confirm the display of product cards. The test title preserves the test case ID as required. No asynchronous handling issues or API misuse detected.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="nav-home"]' appears to relate to a navigation element rather than a product grid containing product cards. This weakens confidence that the product cards are actually displayed on the home page as intended by the test.
issues.recommendation: Use a more precise selector targeting product card containers or items based on available data-test attributes or other stable markers.

issues.description: The test only asserts visibility of a single element, potentially a navigation element, which may not validate the presence of product cards effectively.
issues.recommendation: Include assertions for child elements that represent individual product cards or verify that a collection of product cards is visible and has expected count.

recommendations: Improve selector specificity to target the actual product cards or product grid container.
Enhance assertions to verify content or count of displayed product cards, increasing test reliability.
Consider extracting baseURL into a config or test fixture for better reusability and maintainability.
